scope: Mechanism checks, not local risk calibration or proof of avoided losses

source.title: FEMA P-942, Hurricane Sandy in New Jersey and New York

checks.name: Floodgate overtopping includes wave crest
checks.observed: 42-inch floodgates near stillwater level were overtopped by an additional 1–2 ft wave action; subgrade spaces flooded
checks.status: Mechanism reproduced; observed approximate levels are not precise capacity calibration

checks.name: Backup is a series system
checks.observed: Protected fuel/pumping supported operation; flooded supporting components defeated other backup systems
checks.status: Failure dependency reproduced; component rates and local service probability unvalidated

checks.name: Pumping is not inferred from installed equipment
checks.observed: Six >=100-gpm pumps kept basement below 3 inches, but inflow was not reported
checks.status: Local avoided water depth cannot be identified from that observation; model returns unavailable without inflow/duty

removed_from_authoritative_comparison: task completion counted as avoided harm
